items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: The timeline depends on the project scope. A basic website typically takes 1-2 weeks, while more complex projects with custom features can take 3-4 weeks. I'll provide a detailed timeline during our initial consultation.

items.question: What's included in your web design packages?
items.answer: All packages include custom design, mobile responsiveness, basic SEO setup, and a contact form. Higher-tier packages include additional pages, CMS integration, advanced SEO, analytics setup, and priority support.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance and support?
items.answer: Yes! I offer ongoing maintenance packages to keep your website secure, updated, and running smoothly. This includes regular backups, security updates, content updates, and technical support.

items.question: Can you help with an existing website?
items.answer: Absolutely! I can help redesign, optimize, or add new features to your existing website. We'll assess your current site and create a plan to improve its performance and appearance.

items.question: What platforms do you work with?
items.answer: I work with various platforms including WordPress, Framer, Webflow, GoHighLevel, and custom-coded solutions using React and Next.js. I'll recommend the best platform based on your specific needs and goals.

items.question: How do we communicate during the project?
items.answer: I keep communication clear and consistent through email, video calls, and project management tools. You'll receive regular updates and have opportunities to provide feedback at each stage of the project.
